name: Pochi
relevance: Terminal coding agent for planning, implementation and developer workflows
notes: Research preview. The published CLI uses Node.js; configure authentication and provider settings separately.

name: Amplifier
relevance: Modular terminal agent with composable tools, providers and workflow bundles
notes: Requires uv, git and Python 3.11+. Installs the upstream Git distribution through uv; native Windows is excluded in favor of upstream-supported WSL. Configure providers and bundles separately.

name: Oracle
relevance: Multi-model second opinions with selected repository files and prompts
notes: Requires Node 24+. Configure model credentials or a browser session separately before submitting prompts and files.

name: Summarize
relevance: Extracts and summarizes URLs, documents and media for agent context
notes: Requires Node 24+. Provider credentials and optional media extraction/transcription dependencies are configured separately.

name: Peekaboo
relevance: macOS screen capture and UI automation CLI for AI agents
notes: macOS 15+ only. The canonical repository and Homebrew tap are under openclaw. Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions must be configured separately.

name: CodexBar CLI
relevance: Terminal usage and quota reporting for coding agent providers
notes: This entry installs the CLI formula, including Linux support, rather than the macOS desktop application. Supports macOS/Linux x64 and arm64. Configure provider access separately.

name: CC Switch CLI
relevance: Switches coding agent providers and manages local agent configurations
notes: Installs the cc-switch CLI from Homebrew core on macOS/Linux. Choose providers and configuration changes explicitly. Use brew upgrade rather than the built-in updater for this installation.

name: Google ADK CLI
relevance: Creates, runs and evaluates tool-using agents from the terminal
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. The google-adk distribution supplies the adk CLI. Configure model credentials and initialize agent projects separately.

name: LLM
relevance: Terminal language model client with tools, model plugins and reusable prompts
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. Configure model credentials, optional plugins and tool permissions separately.

name: QMD
relevance: Local hybrid document search and MCP retrieval for agent context
notes: Requires Node 22+. macOS requires Homebrew SQLite for extension support. Choose collections and initialize indexes/model downloads separately; native dependencies have platform-specific requirements.

name: Google Workspace CLI
relevance: Agent-friendly CLI for Google Workspace APIs with structured output
notes: Requires Node 18+. npm downloads the upstream native platform executable. Google API activation, OAuth consent and account authentication are separate setup steps.

name: ClawHub
relevance: Searches and manages reusable agent skills from the ClawHub registry
notes: Requires Node 22+. This installs the registry CLI only. Choose and review individual skills and authentication separately.

name: MCP Inspector
relevance: Inspects and debugs MCP servers and their tool interfaces
notes: Requires Node 22.19+. Version probing is disabled to avoid launching the inspector during detection; npm inventory supplies its version. Connect and authenticate individual MCP servers separately.

name: CASS
relevance: Indexes and searches coding agent conversation histories across tools
notes: The current Homebrew formula supports Apple Silicon macOS and x64/arm64 Linux; Intel macOS is excluded by upstream. Choose session sources and build an index explicitly. Use --robot or --json for agent-facing searches.

name: Destructive Command Guard
relevance: Checks shell commands against configurable destructive-operation rules
notes: Homebrew installs the CLI only. Run dcg install separately to choose and enable coding-agent hooks. Supports macOS/Linux x64 and arm64. Upstream uses a custom license rider; review its license before use.

name: NTM
relevance: Tmux session manager for coordinating multiple coding agents
notes: Supports macOS/Linux x64 and arm64. Homebrew installs tmux as a dependency. Install and authenticate the coding agents you want to coordinate separately.

name: Beads Rust
relevance: Rust issue tracker CLI for durable coding agent task context
notes: Installs the br executable, a separate project from the existing Beads catalog entry. Initialize project tracking explicitly. Supports macOS/Linux x64 and arm64. Upstream uses a custom license rider.

name: Playwright CLI
relevance: Browser automation CLI and reusable browser workflows for coding agents
notes: Requires Node 18+. Browser downloads and optional coding-agent skills are separate setup steps. This direct CLI is distinct from the Playwright MCP server.

name: Playwright MCP
relevance: MCP server exposing Playwright browser automation to AI agents
notes: Requires Node 18+. Configure an MCP client and install browser dependencies separately. Installation does not start the server or connect a browser.

name: FastMCP CLI
relevance: Runs, inspects and integrates Python MCP servers from the terminal
notes: Requires uv and Python 3.10+. FastMCP 4 is a metapackage; the native adapter explicitly exposes the fastmcp-slim dependency executable with uv --with-executables-from. Configure or launch MCP servers separately. Version probing is disabled; the CLI is detected by its executable.
